name: University of Science and Technology of China

evidence.summary: CASI reports that in 2023 the Beijing Institute of Remote Sensing Equipment (the 25th Research Institute of CASIC’s Second Academy), which runs a national defence key laboratory for millimetre-wave remote sensing, set up a joint laboratory for advanced detection and guidance with USTC’s School of Integrated Circuit Science and Engineering.
USTC describes itself as a university that belongs to the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
